documents.title: Missed appointment
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Did not arrive for 8:40 physical. Reached him on the second try; he had it on his calendar for next week and apologized. Rebooked for Wed 10/4 at 8:20, fasting not needed. Reminder text set.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Rescheduled from last month. Now in his fourth year, working toward his qualifying exam this winter, so more hours at the desk and less sleep some weeks, but says mood is even and his psychiatrist agrees. Still lithium 600 BID, no missed doses he can think of.

NKDA. Never smoker, no alcohol.
ROS: negative. No tremor, no thirst or urinary change.

Exam: vitals as charted. Neck without goiter. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear throughout. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities fine. Fine motor normal.
PHQ-9 4, mostly sleep and energy items; he links it to exam prep.

A/P
1. Bipolar I on lithium: annual BMP, TSH, CBC and lithium level drawn; results to psychiatry.
2. Sleep: talked about keeping a regular schedule through exam season, which his psychiatrist has also stressed with him.
3. Flu and updated COVID given.
Next physical in a year.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Gavin, your labs are back and look good. Sodium, kidney function, calcium, thyroid and blood counts are normal and the lithium level is 0.7. Forwarded to psychiatry. Good luck with quals.

documents.title: Pharmacy refill request - lithium
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pharmacy faxed a request for lithium carbonate 300 mg caps, 120 count, to be sent by us. Prescriber on file is his psychiatrist. Called pt: he has 4 days left and his psychiatrist is away this week. Called the psychiatry office, the covering psychiatrist will send it today. Pharmacy updated, pt aware. No Rx sent from here.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
26 y/o grad student, passed his qualifying exam, now writing. Sees psychiatry every 3 months, lithium unchanged at 600 BID, mood stable. No complaints today.

NKDA. No tobacco, no alcohol, no drugs.
ROS: negative. Specifically denies increased thirst, nighttime urination, tremor, rash.

Exam: vitals in chart, weight unchanged from last year. Thyroid not palpable. RRR, no murmur. Clear lungs. Abdomen benign. No edema. No tremor.
PHQ-9 3.

A/P
- Bipolar I disorder, stable: yearly lithium monitoring labs today, copy to psychiatry.
- Flu and this year's COVID vaccine given.
- Nothing else due at his age. Back in a year.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Gavin, labs are normal: sodium and kidney function in range, thyroid fine, blood counts fine, lithium 0.8. Sent to your psychiatrist.
